+def get_bsd_uptime_facts(module):
+    sysctl_cmd = module.get_bin_path('sysctl')
+    if not sysctl_cmd:

+
+    try:
+        rc, out, err = module.run_command([sysctl_cmd, '-n', 'kern.boottime'])
+    except (IOError, OSError) as exc:

+from __future__ import (absolute_import, division, print_function)
+__metaclass__ = type
+
+import pytest
+
+from units.compat.mock import Mock
+
+from ansible.module_utils.facts.hardware.darwin import DarwinHardware
+from ansible.module_utils.facts.hardware.freebsd import FreeBSDHardware
+from ansible.module_utils.facts.hardware.netbsd import NetBSDHardware
+from ansible.module_utils.facts.hardware.openbsd import OpenBSDHardware
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('hardware_class,fact_methods', [
+    (FreeBSDHardware, ('get_cpu_facts', 'get_memory_facts', 'get_dmi_facts',
+                       'get_device_facts', 'get_mount_facts')),
+    (OpenBSDHardware, ('get_processor_facts', 'get_memory_facts', 'get_dmi_facts',
+                       'get_device_facts', 'get_mount_facts')),
+    (NetBSDHardware, ('get_cpu_facts', 'get_memory_facts', 'get_dmi_facts',
+                      'get_mount_facts')),
+    (DarwinHardware, ('get_mac_facts', 'get_cpu_facts', 'get_memory_facts')),
+])
+def test_bsd_populate_keeps_all_facts_and_uptime(mocker, hardware_class, fact_methods):
+    module = Mock()
+    module.get_bin_path.return_value = '/sbin/sysctl'
+    module.run_command.return_value = (0, '1000\n', '')
+    mocker.patch('ansible.module_utils.facts.sysctl.time.time', return_value=2000)
+
+    if hardware_class is not FreeBSDHardware:
+        mocker.patch(hardware_class.__module__ + '.get_sysctl', return_value={})
+    for method in fact_methods:
+        mocker.patch.object(hardware_class, method, return_value={method: method})
+
+    facts = hardware_class(module).populate()
+
+    assert facts == dict([(method, method) for method in fact_methods] +
+                         [('uptime_seconds', 1000)])
+
+
+def test_openbsd_populate_keeps_valid_sysctl_facts_after_malformed_line(mocker):
+    module = Mock()
+    module.get_bin_path.return_value = '/sbin/sysctl'
+    module.run_command.side_effect = [
+        (0, 'hw.ncpu=2\nhw.model: Test CPU\nmalformed\n'
+            'hw.disknames sd0,sd1\nhw.vendor=Example\n', ''),
+        (0, '1000\n', ''),
+    ]
+    mocker.patch('ansible.module_utils.facts.sysctl.time.time', return_value=2000)
+    mocker.patch.object(OpenBSDHardware, 'get_memory_facts', return_value={'memtotal_mb': 512})
+    mocker.patch.object(OpenBSDHardware, 'get_mount_facts', return_value={'mounts': []})
+
+    facts = OpenBSDHardware(module).populate()
+
+    assert facts['processor'] == ['Test CPU', 'Test CPU']
+    assert facts['processor_count'] == '2'
+    assert facts['devices'] == ['sd0', 'sd1']
+    assert facts['system_vendor'] == 'Example'
+    assert facts['memtotal_mb'] == 512
+    assert facts['mounts'] == []
+    assert facts['uptime_seconds'] == 1000
+    assert module.warn.call_count == 1
+    assert module.warn.call_args[0][0].startswith('Unable to split sysctl line (malformed): ')

@@ -0,0 +1,102 @@
+from __future__ import (absolute_import, division, print_function)
+__metaclass__ = type
+
+import errno
+
+import pytest
+
+from units.compat.mock import Mock
+
+from ansible.module_utils.facts.sysctl import get_bsd_uptime_facts, get_sysctl
+
+
+def test_get_sysctl_parses_formats_and_continuations():
+    module = Mock()
+    module.get_bin_path.return_value = '/sbin/sysctl'
+    module.run_command.return_value = (0, 'hw.model=OpenBSD model\n'
+                                        'kern.boottime: 1000\n'
+                                        'hw.features feature set\n'
+                                        'hw.description: first line\n'
+                                        '  second: line\n'
+                                        '\n'
+                                        '\tthird = line\n'
+                                        'malformed\n'
+                                        'hw.ncpu = 4\n', '')
+
+    facts = get_sysctl(module, ['hw', 'kern'])
+
+    assert facts == {'hw.model': 'OpenBSD model',
+                     'kern.boottime': '1000',
+                     'hw.features': 'feature set',
+                     'hw.description': 'first line\n  second: line\n\n\tthird = line',
+                     'hw.ncpu': '4'}
+    module.run_command.assert_called_once_with(['/sbin/sysctl', 'hw', 'kern'])
+    assert module.warn.call_count == 1
+    assert module.warn.call_args[0][0].startswith('Unable to split sysctl line (malformed): ')
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('failure,warning', [
+    ((2, 'hw.ncpu = 4', 'permission denied'), 'Unable to read sysctl: permission denied'),
+    (OSError('read failed'), 'Unable to read sysctl: read failed'),
+])
+def test_get_sysctl_command_failure(failure, warning):
+    module = Mock()
+    module.get_bin_path.return_value = '/sbin/sysctl'
+    if isinstance(failure, tuple):
+        module.run_command.return_value = failure
+    else:
+        module.run_command.side_effect = failure
+
+    assert get_sysctl(module, ['hw']) == {}
+    module.warn.assert_called_once_with(warning)
+
+
+def test_get_sysctl_requires_binary():
+    module = Mock()
+    module.get_bin_path.return_value = None
+
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
+        get_sysctl(module, ['hw'])
+
+
+def test_get_bsd_uptime_facts_uses_numeric_boot_time(mocker):
+    module = Mock()
+    module.get_bin_path.return_value = '/sbin/sysctl'
+    module.run_command.return_value = (0, '1000\n', '')
+    mocker.patch('ansible.module_utils.facts.sysctl.time.time', return_value=2000.75)
+
+    assert get_bsd_uptime_facts(module) == {'uptime_seconds': 1000}
+    module.run_command.assert_called_once_with(['/sbin/sysctl', '-n', 'kern.boottime'])
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('result', [
+    (1, '1000', 'permission denied'),
+    (0, '', ''),
+    (0, '  \n', ''),
+    (0, 'not-a-number', ''),
+    (0, '{ sec = 1000, usec = 0 }', ''),
+    (0, '1000\n1001', ''),
+])
+def test_get_bsd_uptime_facts_omits_unusable_boot_time(result):
+    module = Mock()
+    module.get_bin_path.return_value = '/sbin/sysctl'
+    module.run_command.return_value = result
+
+    assert get_bsd_uptime_facts(module) == {}
+
+
+def test_get_bsd_uptime_facts_requires_binary():
+    module = Mock()
+    module.get_bin_path.return_value = None
+
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
+        get_bsd_uptime_facts(module)
+
+
+def test_get_bsd_uptime_facts_missing_binary_on_execution():
+    module = Mock()
+    module.get_bin_path.return_value = '/sbin/sysctl'
+    module.run_command.side_effect = OSError(errno.ENOENT, 'No such file or directory')
+
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
+        get_bsd_uptime_facts(module)
